sourceSnapshot.popupDisplayTextKo: 폐광 입구의 무너진 숙소에는 김이 오르는 밥상이 차려져 있었다. 사람의 흔적은 없는데도 그릇은 광부 수만큼 놓였고, 빈자리 하나에는 깨진 안전패가 올려져 있었다. 음식에서는 구수한 냄새가 났지만 천장에는 갱도 붕괴 때 묻힌 이들의 이름이 검댕으로 빼곡히 적혀 있었다.

Act01 random event popup main image for '버려진 광부의 저녁상'. Show the pre-choice situation and core visual clues from the source event, not result/reward scenes. 3:4 vertical painted Korean dark fantasy RPG story-popup image. No UI, caption, logo, readable text, speech bubble, button, or label.

notes: Do not route or call ImageGen until user/provider execution approval is recorded.

requiredElements: A single 3:4 vertical story-popup main image for the Act01 Cheongun Sangui random event.
Depict the pre-choice situation and core story clue from the source popup, not an outcome, reward, battle-clear, or victory moment.
Keep the illustration readable behind popup UI overlays with uncluttered lower text space and no readable text inside the image.
Use Korean dark fantasy/Joseon rural visual grounding: period-appropriate clothing, props, architecture, weather, soil, wood, stone, fabric and ritual objects.
Maintain one clear focal moment with foreground/midground/background depth and a stable composition suitable for a stage popup main image.
Specific event clue: cold meal, mine timbers, dust, ghostly presence
Source popup title: 버려진 광부의 저녁상
prohibitedElements: Do not include UI overlays, buttons, captions, subtitles, labels, logos, watermarks, speech bubbles, comic text, readable writing, or result/reward/victory text.
Do not show a completed reward scene, victory pose, loot payout, result screen, or choice result; depict only the pre-choice dramatic situation.
Do not depict modern objects, modern typography, modern signage, anachronistic clothing, or non-Joseon fantasy armor as the focus.
Do not place critical story clues under the lower popup text overlay or near the outermost edges.
Do not overfill the canvas with small details that cannot read behind the story popup UI.

backgroundSpecification.horizon: Low-to-middle horizon unless the source scene requires a shaft, grave mound, eave, or mountain path vertical emphasis; never let horizon split the lower UI-safe text area.
